levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: One or more of the three totals (three single rides, day pass, three QuickHop rides) is calculated incorrectly or a ride leg is miscounted.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: All three totals are attempted with the correct ride-leg count, but one arithmetic total is off.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three totals are calculated correctly using the given fare numbers and the correct count of three ride legs.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: States which option costs least without referencing the calculated totals or the specific number of ride legs.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names the least expensive option and explains the choice by directly comparing the calculated totals for this specific three-leg trip.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
